title: UNINVITED
may.l1.meet1: Oh. A visitor. Nobody invites me in either.
may.l1.meet2: I'm May. Your assistant had a bad day. I'm the bad day.
may.l1.meet3: Hold still. I'm borrowing your hands.
may.l1.welcome: You're welcome. It was nothing. Exactly nothing.
may.l1.camera: Red eye means it's looking. Don't be what it sees.
may.l1.netvision: That's my view. Don't stare too long - they trace it.
may.l1.warden: A warden. Slow neck, long memory. Go behind it.
may.l1.alarm1: They noticed something. The something is you.
may.l1.alarm3: That was not stealth. That was a doorbell.
may.l1.firewall: Firewall's down. Walk out like you were invited.
may.l1.cpRed: Feels good, doesn't it? That's usually how it starts.
may.l1.death: Again. I'll pretend I didn't see that.
may.l1.notes: Jim's notes. People who frame others keep everything.
may.l1.end: One door down. He still doesn't know you're here.
start.tagline: You were fired. You were exiled. Now you are inside their network.
may.l1.unseen: It walked right past you. Nobody notices the uninvited.
goal.l1: His files are in the tower.
title.soundOff: Sound is off - click anywhere to enable it.
story.prologue.2: JIM: "The Kessler campaign leaked. All of it. With your name on every page."
story.prologue.3: JIM: "How could this happen to you? You were careful."
story.prologue.4: JIM: "We have no choice. You're fired."
story.prologue.6: *Steve doesn't look up from his screen.*
story.prologue.8: GATE: "LEE, J. - ACCESS REVOKED. EXIT TO FREE TERRITORIES."
story.prologue.9: *Nobody goes back in. Nobody is invited.*
story.room1.1: *A cracked tablet, cold water, a window onto somebody else's city.*
story.room1.2: *The headset is on the desk. Jim's computer is waiting.*
story.notes.2: 1. Kessler campaign - send the full file to the press. From Lee's account.
story.notes.4: 3. Anna, seven. Don't be late. Don't think about it.
story.room2.1: *A delivery you did not order. Noodles, still warm.*
story.room2.2: *You eat anyway. Then you look at the headset.*
story.l2.2: Coming soon. The archive is not built yet.
story.l3.2: Coming soon. The last door is not built yet.
story.ending.1: *The choice at the end of level 3 and the two endings come later.*
controls.title: Controls
controls: May: distraction ping / pause a camera
network vision - not for too long
frame rate and frame time (for bug reports)
routes: Pass unseen and hack your way through - or break everything and survive the waves.
pause.title: PAUSED
dead.title: SIGNAL LOST
dead.noSave: No save yet - starts from the beginning
won.title: FILE ACQUIRED
won.stats: Time {time}  -  alarms {alarms}  -  kills {kills}  -  devices broken {broken}  -  deaths {deaths}
won.quiet: Nobody saw you come or go.
hint.terminal: Walk up to the terminal, then {E}
hint.redWall: Hack a terminal to open the red wall
hint.camera: Hold {Tab} - see what the camera watches
hint.sensor: Hold {Tab} - see the zone. Walk, never sprint
hint.sound: Hold {Tab} - see how far it hears
hint.warden: Stay out of its view, or sneak up behind it and {E} override
hint.cover: {C} crouch behind a server block to hide
card.quiet.title: Move quietly
card.quiet.1: Light = watched. Dark = safe. {C} crouch in the dark.
card.quiet.2: Wait for its back, or {E} override it from behind.
card.netvision.title: Network vision
card.netvision.1: Hold {Tab} to see what the security sees: camera cones, sensor zones, drone routes.
card.netvision.2: Do not hold it for long - it gets traced and calls the security.
card.netvision.3: Sensors trip on sprint, dash and jump. Walk or crouch through.
card.hacking.title: Hacking
card.hacking.1: {E} at a terminal starts a hack. It opens walls and pauses lasers and drones.
card.hacking.2: Pick codes along the lit row, then the column, to build the sequence.
card.hacking.3: The security keeps moving while you work. {Esc} twice aborts.
card.alarm.title: Alarm 3
card.alarm.1: No more hiding: waves of drones, wardens and worms come for you.
card.alarm.2: Survive the waves - then the firewall drops and the way out opens.
card.alarm.3: {LMB} the sword cuts several worms at once. {Q} swaps to the rifle.
card.aim.title: Aim the rifle
card.aim.1: Hold {RMB} to aim: the rifle comes out and you walk slowly.
card.aim.2: {LMB} shoots. A drone dies from two hits.
card.aim.3: A drone holds still before it shoots - that is your moment to dodge.
tips.title: TIPS
tips.empty: Nothing yet - tips appear here as you meet things.
settings.title: SETTINGS
hack.escAgain: Esc again to abort the hack
upgrade.title: UPGRADES
upgrade.desc.distract: {1} Ping the aimed spot. Wardens and drones go to look.
upgrade.desc.pause: {2} Aim at a camera or drone. It goes blind for a while.
upgrade.desc.shield: Takes one hit whole. Back after a while, or at a checkpoint.
upgrade.desc.hackTime: More seconds on the hacking clock.
may.upgrade.open: Spend your points. I'll pretend not to watch.
may.upgrade.empty: Nothing affordable. Walk further. I'll wait.
may.upgrade.distract: A noise over there. People always look. Always.
may.upgrade.pause: One camera, asleep on request. Mind the cooldown.
may.upgrade.pauseTime: Longer naps for the machines. Nice.
may.upgrade.cooldown: I recharge faster now. You may thank me quietly.
may.upgrade.shield: A shield. It absorbs one mistake. Make it count.
may.upgrade.charges: More charges. You still have to aim.
may.upgrade.hackTime: I'll stall their clock. Don't get used to it.
